pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome to London Park Schools | London Park Schools
pageCache.text:
London Park Schools is a group of schools, offering a fresh approach to secondary schooling, one that is dynamic, forward‑thinking, and deliberately designed around a tight‑knit school community.
LPS is made up of LPS Clapham, a senior school in South West London for students aged 11-16, LPS Mayfair, a senior school in central London for students aged 11-16, LPS Sixth a sixth form for students aged 16-18 located in Mayfair, LPS Hybrid, school for students aged 11-18 to attend school remotely four days a week, and in person one day a week at the Mayfair school.

pageCache.pageTitle: Aims and Ethos | Private School Clapham | London Park Schools
pageCache.text:
London Park Schools offers a fresh approach to secondary schooling, one that is dynamic, forward-thinking, and deliberately designed around a tight-knit school community. By ensuring every child is deeply known, fully supported, and consistently stretched, LPS unlocks new levels of confidence and capability in students, so they can thrive thanks to LPS’ unique, experiential approach to learning, students are equipped not only with strong academic foundations, but also with the skills, self-belief, and adaptability they need to succeed in their future endeavours.
The LPS values: Our four ‘Cs’ of success Our four Cs are at the heart of all that we do. These values empower each student to think independently, engage actively, develop the important problem-solving skills necessary for future success, and learn to lead with integrity.

pageCache.pageTitle: Inspection Reports | Hybrid School UK | London Park Schools
pageCache.text:
You can take a look at the Ofsted and inspection reports for all of the London Park Schools below.
Visit the 2025 ISI Summary page.

Together we’re extraordinary
London Park Schools is part of the Dukes Education family of schools and educators, brought together by a common purpose: to give children the foundations for an extraordinary life.
About Dukes Education
Dukes Education is a family of schools, teachers, learners, and parents connected by our pursuit of an extraordinary life for every member of our community.
Our philosophy is to support each individual to live with purpose, to encourage a love of learning, and to act as a team. All of this is underpinned by a quality standard that runs through everything we do.
We believe that education is a journey to be enjoyed and shared at every stage of life, unlocking possibilities for every student.
To learn more about the Dukes Education family, visit dukeseducation.com
We create clusters of nurseries and schools in village locations to ensure that families can enjoy the option of an all-through education journey with Dukes Education within their local area.
Continuity and Confidence
As students move through their educational journey, our guaranteed entry policy offers a seamless progression within the Dukes family, with assured entry at key entry points such as Year 7 and Year 12. This transition is subject only to the availability of a place and a child’s ability to thrive within the school’s ethos and curriculum, providing continuity without the need for traditional entrance exams like the 11+.
Guaranteed Placement, Tailored Support
Dukes Education is committed to supporting each child’s journey into senior school. We work closely with families to ensure each student finds their place, supporting their unique strengths and aspirations.
Our commitment to providing a guaranteed place at a Dukes senior school allows students to focus on their personal and academic growth without the added pressure of entrance exams. For families opting to apply to other selective senior schools, our prep schools offer comprehensive guidance, tailored 11+ preparation, and outstanding pastoral support, ensuring that each student is fully prepared to perform at their best.
For families who decide their child will not sit the 11+ entrance test, we are often able to confirm a place in a Dukes senior school such as LPS Clapham or LPS Mayfair, by September of Year 6. Early acceptance offers peace of mind, allowing students to enjoy their final years of prep school with confidence, focusing on a positive and seamless transition to senior school.
The Dukes Club is an extraordinary community of parents, pupils, staff and alumni that connects families across all the Dukes Education nurseries, schools and colleges. It is a space to learn, network, take advantage of exciting opportunities and amazing rewards, and make new friends. If you are a parent with a child at a Dukes Education school, college or nursery, we warmly invite you to join. As a growing family of education settings, our scale and scope enable us to provide you with exclusive access to a huge array of opportunities that would simply be beyond the reach of any single school.
The Dukes Foundation
The Dukes Foundation was born out of the belief that a person’s early years are their most formative – the ones that shape us into who we’ll be. With our roots in education, we know how vital it is for young people to have the right support, encouragement, and opportunities during this important chapter in their lives.
We want to harness the powerful and uniting spirit of Dukes Education to make a meaningful difference in ways far beyond the boundaries of our organisation. To create a world of inspiration. To see through adversity, to see the potential in every person and to find opportunity in every corner of the world.
Through grant-making and partnerships, we proudly support life-changing charities and organisations who share our ambition. From education and financial assistance, to health, well-being and environmental causes, we can create sparks that can ignite brighter futures.
Find out more about the Dukes Foundation
Dukes Plus is a provider of university application support, life-changing career and university experiences, day camps, tuition, and summer schools.
We are here, so you can get there
By bringing together our exceptional brands under Dukes Plus, we can provide a complete range of industry-leading services that assist students throughout their educational path, nurturing their development and establishing a solid groundwork for a bright future.
Find out more about Dukes Plus

pageCache.pageTitle: LPS Mayfair & Sixth ISI Inspection 2025 - London Park Schools
pageCache.text:
From 7–9 October 2025, the Independent Schools Inspectorate visited LPS Mayfair and LPS Sixth, meeting students and staff across all three of our pathways: Day, Hybrid and Sixth Form.
We are delighted to share that we met all the Independent School Standards — the strongest possible outcome under the current ISI framework.
This result reflects not only compliance, but the depth of culture, care and purpose that define our school.
“The school’s values… are understood well by students.”ISI, October 2025
Across all pathways, inspectors saw confident learners, strong relationships and a community grounded in collaboration, creativity, courage and compassion.
Since the ISI framework changed in 2023, inspections have become significantly more demanding. Schools are no longer awarded graded outcomes such as Excellent or Good. Instead, they must show that they fully meet every individual standard. If even one area does not meet the requirement, the overall judgement reflects that.
In this context, achieving “standards met” across all areas is a meaningful accomplishment.
strong, consistent leadership
secure, well-understood safeguarding
high-quality teaching and curriculum planning
students who are well supported
systems and values that are lived day to day
As we shared with parents, under the revised framework meeting all standards “is no small feat”.This outcome is a confident endorsement of our values, our leadership and our modern approach to education.
“Learn Like a Londoner” is the shared philosophy across all London Park Schools. It captures an attitude to learning that is:
connected to real experiences
enriched by opportunities beyond the classroom
grounded in shared values
delivered within small, personal school communities with wide horizons
Inspectors saw this throughout the school and across all streams — in the tone of teaching, the confidence of our students and the strength of relationships throughout the school.
Inspectors recognised the clarity, consistency and warmth that shape daily life.
“Students behave well and understand the importance of respect for all.”
“Students communicate clearly and with confidence.”
“Students engage in their work with determination.”
They praised teaching that is well planned and responsive to individual needs, and noted the strength of relationships across year groups. The atmosphere was described as calm, inclusive and purposeful — a school where students feel grounded and ready to learn.
Our Hybrid stream is a distinctive and growing part of LPS Mayfair. Inspectors highlighted its thoughtful design and positive impact.
“Leaders have put robust procedures in place to ensure that students who learn mainly online are safe.”
“Dedicated online lessons deepen students’ knowledge and understanding.”
“Attendance for hybrid learners is checked rigorously.”
They recognised the careful planning, strong staff training and the way Hybrid helps students reconnect with learning, rebuild confidence and sustain belonging.
Hybrid continues to demonstrate its value as a flexible, well-supported pathway for students who benefit from a different structure.
At LPS Sixth, inspectors saw maturity, ambition and a clear sense of direction among our oldest students.
“Sixth Form students receive individualised and structured support in the careers programme.”
Students communicated with confidence, took responsibility for their learning and showed real clarity about their next steps.LPS Sixth is a place where young people grow as individuals and prepare confidently for university and life beyond school.
Inspectors praised the quality of education across Day, Hybrid and Sixth:
well-planned lessons
a broad, sequenced curriculum
helpful, structured feedback
excellent SEND and EAL support
“Lessons are carefully planned, helping students make good progress.”
“The curriculum is broad, well sequenced and accessible, including for students who learn mainly online.”
“SEND students are supported well to access the curriculum and wider school life.”
These findings highlight the consistency, care and ambition that underpin learning across the school.
Safeguarding was recognised as strong and carefully led.
“Leaders with responsibility for safeguarding have a deep understanding of contextual risks.”
“Monitoring and filtering of online activity is effective and regularly reviewed.”
“Staff make safeguarding reports without delay.”
Inspectors also highlighted positive behaviour, respectful relationships and pastoral care that helps students feel known and supported.
Leadership was described as reflective and community-minded, with a clear sense of direction and strong communication.
“Leaders listen carefully to students, staff and parents.”
“Governors maintain effective oversight and meet regularly with students and staff.”
Inspectors recognised the strength and coherence of systems across the school and the sense of purpose shared by the whole community.
Inspectors made a single recommendation:
“Ensure younger students’ views and needs are fully considered in planning careers advice.”
This work is already underway within our Years 7–9 programme.
Inspectors saw students who understand and live the London Park Schools’ values of Collaboration, Creativity, Courage and Compassion.
Relationships across the school were described as positive and supportive:
“Relationships between students… are warm and understanding.”
“Students voice their views and opinions thoughtfully and with confidence.”
Visitors often comment on the calm and friendly feel of the school, and inspectors recognised this too:
“Students behave well and understand the importance of respect for all.”
Dr Adrian Rainbow, Head of LPS Mayfair, Hybrid & Sixth
“This report captures the community we see every day: students who feel known, teachers who understand them, and a culture shaped by shared values.”
Suzie Longstaff, Managing Director, Dukes Education (London Schools South & Central)
“Smaller settings, personal relationships and a modern educational outlook are helping our students thrive. This is a wonderful moment for the whole LPS group. With LPS Clapham judged ‘Outstanding’ by Ofsted last year, and now LPS Mayfair, Hybrid and Sixth meeting all ISI standards, all London Park School pathways are not only delivering something genuinely exciting, but doing it really well.”
This ISI report reflects a school where students feel safe, supported and known. It highlights teaching that helps students learn with confidence, relationships that give them a sense of belonging, and leadership that listens carefully and acts with clarity.
The inspection confirms that we are:
confident and inclusive
values-led and forward-looking
small in scale and rich in opportunity
thriving across all three pathways
We are proud of our students, staff and families — and excited for what comes next.
